1.web: After he had finished speaking in the hearing of the people, he entered into Capernaum.
1.asv: After he had ended all his sayings in the ears of the people, he entered into Capernaum.

2.web: A certain centurion’s servant, who was dear to him, was sick and at the point of death.
2.asv: And a certain centurion’s servant, who was dear unto him, was sick and at the point of death.

3.web: When he heard about Jesus, he sent to him elders of the Jews, asking him to come and save his servant.
3.asv: And when he heard concerning Jesus, he sent unto him elders of the Jews, asking him that he would come and save his servant.

4.web: When they came to Jesus, they begged him earnestly, saying, “He is worthy for you to do this for him,
4.asv: And they, when they came to Jesus, besought him earnestly, saying, He is worthy that thou shouldest do this for him;

5.web: for he loves our nation, and he built our synagogue for us.”
5.asv: for he loveth our nation, and himself built us our synagogue.

6.web: Jesus went with them. When he was now not far from the house, the centurion sent friends to him, saying to him, “Lord, don’t trouble yourself, for I am not worthy for you to come under my roof.
6.asv: And Jesus went with them. And when he was now not far from the house, the centurion sent friends to him, saying unto him, Lord, trouble not thyself; for I am not worthy that thou shouldest come under my roof:

7.web: Therefore I didn’t even think myself worthy to come to you; but say the word, and my servant will be healed.
7.asv: wherefore neither thought I myself worthy to come unto thee: but say the word, and my servant shall be healed.

8.web: For I also am a man placed under authority, having under myself soldiers. I tell this one, ‘Go!’ and he goes; and to another, ‘Come!’ and he comes; and to my servant, ‘Do this,’ and he does it.”
8.asv: For I also am a man set under authority, having under myself soldiers: and I say to this one, Go, and he goeth; and to another, Come, and he cometh; and to my servant, Do this, and he doeth it.

9.web: When Jesus heard these things, he marveled at him, and turned and said to the multitude who followed him, “I tell you, I have not found such great faith, no, not in Israel.”
9.asv: And when Jesus heard these things, he marvelled at him, and turned and said unto the multitude that followed him, I say unto you, I have not found so great faith, no, not in Israel.

10.web: Those who were sent, returning to the house, found that the servant who had been sick was well.
10.asv: And they that were sent, returning to the house, found the servant whole.

11.web: Soon afterwards, he went to a city called Nain. Many of his disciples, along with a great multitude, went with him.
11.asv: And it came to pass soon afterwards, that he went to a city called Nain; and his disciples went with him, and a great multitude.

12.web: Now when he drew near to the gate of the city, behold, one who was dead was carried out, the only son of his mother, and she was a widow. Many people of the city were with her.
12.asv: Now when he drew near to the gate of the city, behold, there was carried out one that was dead, the only son of his mother, and she was a widow: and much people of the city was with her.

13.web: When the Lord saw her, he had compassion on her, and said to her, “Don’t cry.”
13.asv: And when the Lord saw her, he had compassion on her, and said unto her, Weep not.

14.web: He came near and touched the coffin, and the bearers stood still. He said, “Young man, I tell you, arise!”
14.asv: And he came nigh and touched the bier: and the bearers stood still. And he said, Young man, I say unto thee, Arise.

15.web: He who was dead sat up, and began to speak. And he gave him to his mother.
15.asv: And he that was dead sat up, and began to speak. And he gave him to his mother.

16.web: Fear took hold of all, and they glorified God, saying, “A great prophet has arisen among us!” and, “God has visited his people!”
16.asv: And fear took hold on all: and they glorified God, saying, A great prophet is arisen among us: and, God hath visited his people.

17.web: This report went out concerning him in the whole of Judea, and in all the surrounding region.
17.asv: And this report went forth concerning him in the whole of Judæa, and all the region round about.

18.web: The disciples of John told him about all these things.
18.asv: And the disciples of John told him of all these things.

19.web: John, calling to himself two of his disciples, sent them to Jesus, saying, “Are you the one who is coming, or should we look for another?”
19.asv: And John calling unto him two of his disciples sent them to the Lord, saying, Art thou he that cometh, or look we for another?

20.web: When the men had come to him, they said, “John the Baptizer has sent us to you, saying, ‘Are you he who comes, or should we look for another?’”
20.asv: And when the men were come unto him, they said, John the Baptist hath sent us unto thee, saying, Art thou he that cometh, or look we for another?

21.web: In that hour he cured many of diseases and plagues and evil spirits; and to many who were blind he gave sight.
21.asv: In that hour he cured many of diseases and plagues and evil spirits; and on many that were blind he bestowed sight.

22.web: Jesus answered them, “Go and tell John the things which you have seen and heard: that the blind receive their sight, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised up, and the poor have good news preached to them.
22.asv: And he answered and said unto them, Go and tell John the things which ye have seen and heard; the blind receive their sight, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, and the deaf hear, the dead are raised up, the poor have good tidings preached to them.

23.web: Blessed is he who finds no occasion for stumbling in me.”
23.asv: And blessed is he, whosoever shall find no occasion of stumbling in me.

24.web: When John’s messengers had departed, he began to tell the multitudes about John, “What did you go out into the wilderness to see? A reed shaken by the wind?
24.asv: And when the messengers of John were departed, he began to say unto the multitudes concerning John, What went ye out into the wilderness to behold? a reed shaken with the wind?

25.web: But what did you go out to see? A man clothed in soft clothing? Behold, those who are gorgeously dressed, and live delicately, are in kings’ courts.
25.asv: But what went ye out to see? a man clothed in soft raiment? Behold, they that are gorgeously apparelled, and live delicately, are in kings’ courts.

26.web: But what did you go out to see? A prophet? Yes, I tell you, and much more than a prophet.
26.asv: But what went ye out to see? a prophet? Yea, I say unto you, and much more than a prophet.

27.web: This is he of whom it is written, ‘Behold, I send my messenger before your face, who will prepare your way before you.’
27.asv: This is he of whom it is written, Behold, I send my messenger before thy face, Who shall prepare thy way before thee.

28.web: “For I tell you, among those who are born of women there is not a greater prophet than John the Baptizer, yet he who is least in the Kingdom of God is greater than he.”
28.asv: I say unto you, Among them that are born of women there is none greater than John: yet he that is but little in the kingdom of God is greater than he.

29.web: When all the people and the tax collectors heard this, they declared God to be just, having been baptized with John’s baptism.
29.asv: And all the people when they heard, and the publicans, justified God, being baptized with the baptism of John.

30.web: But the Pharisees and the lawyers rejected the counsel of God, not being baptized by him themselves.
30.asv: But the Pharisees and the lawyers rejected for themselves the counsel of God, being not baptized of him.

31.web: “To what then will I liken the people of this generation? What are they like?
31.asv: Whereunto then shall I liken the men of this generation, and to what are they like?

32.web: They are like children who sit in the marketplace, and call one to another, saying, ‘We piped to you, and you didn’t dance. We mourned, and you didn’t weep.’
32.asv: They are like unto children that sit in the marketplace, and call one to another; who say, We piped unto you, and ye did not dance; we wailed, and ye did not weep.

33.web: For John the Baptizer came neither eating bread nor drinking wine, and you say, ‘He has a demon.’
33.asv: For John the Baptist is come eating no bread nor drinking wine; and ye say, He hath a demon.

34.web: The Son of Man has come eating and drinking, and you say, ‘Behold, a gluttonous man, and a drunkard; a friend of tax collectors and sinners!’
34.asv: The Son of man is come eating and drinking; and ye say, Behold, a gluttonous man, and a winebibber, a friend of publicans and sinners!

35.web: Wisdom is justified by all her children.”
35.asv: And wisdom is justified of all her children.

36.web: One of the Pharisees invited him to eat with him. He entered into the Pharisee’s house, and sat at the table.
36.asv: And one of the Pharisees desired him that he would eat with him. And he entered into the Pharisee’s house, and sat down to meat.

37.web: Behold, a woman in the city who was a sinner, when she knew that he was reclining in the Pharisee’s house, she brought an alabaster jar of ointment.
37.asv: And behold, a woman who was in the city, a sinner; and when she knew that he was sitting at meat in the Pharisee’s house, she brought an alabaster cruse of ointment,

38.web: Standing behind at his feet weeping, she began to wet his feet with her tears, and she wiped them with the hair of her head, kissed his feet, and anointed them with the ointment.
38.asv: and standing behind at his feet, weeping, she began to wet his feet with her tears, and wiped them with the hair of her head, and kissed his feet, and anointed them with the ointment.

39.web: Now when the Pharisee who had invited him saw it, he said to himself, “This man, if he were a prophet, would have perceived who and what kind of woman this is who touches him, that she is a sinner.”
39.asv: Now when the Pharisee that had bidden him saw it, he spake within himself, saying, This man, if he were a prophet, would have perceived who and what manner of woman this is that toucheth him, that she is a sinner.

40.web: Jesus answered him, “Simon, I have something to tell you.” He said, “Teacher, say on.”
40.asv: And Jesus answering said unto him, Simon, I have somewhat to say unto thee. And he saith, Teacher, say on.

41.web: “A certain lender had two debtors. The one owed five hundred denarii, and the other fifty.
41.asv: A certain lender had two debtors: the one owed five hundred shillings, and the other fifty.

42.web: When they couldn’t pay, he forgave them both. Which of them therefore will love him most?”
42.asv: When they had not wherewith to pay, he forgave them both. Which of them therefore will love him most?

43.web: Simon answered, “He, I suppose, to whom he forgave the most.” He said to him, “You have judged correctly.”
43.asv: Simon answered and said, He, I suppose, to whom he forgave the most. And he said unto him, Thou hast rightly judged.

44.web: Turning to the woman, he said to Simon, “Do you see this woman? I entered into your house, and you gave me no water for my feet, but she has wet my feet with her tears, and wiped them with the hair of her head.
44.asv: And turning to the woman, he said unto Simon, Seest thou this woman? I entered into thy house, thou gavest me no water for my feet: but she hath wetted my feet with her tears, and wiped them with her hair.

45.web: You gave me no kiss, but she, since the time I came in, has not ceased to kiss my feet.
45.asv: Thou gavest me no kiss: but she, since the time I came in, hath not ceased to kiss my feet.

46.web: You didn’t anoint my head with oil, but she has anointed my feet with ointment.
46.asv: My head with oil thou didst not anoint: but she hath anointed my feet with ointment.

47.web: Therefore I tell you, her sins, which are many, are forgiven, for she loved much. But to whom little is forgiven, the same loves little.”
47.asv: Wherefore I say unto thee, Her sins, which are many, are forgiven; for she loved much: but to whom little is forgiven, the same loveth little.

48.web: He said to her, “Your sins are forgiven.”
48.asv: And he said unto her, Thy sins are forgiven.

49.web: Those who sat at the table with him began to say to themselves, “Who is this who even forgives sins?”
49.asv: And they that sat at meat with him began to say within themselves, Who is this that even forgiveth sins?

50.web: He said to the woman, “Your faith has saved you. Go in peace.”
50.asv: And he said unto the woman, Thy faith hath saved thee; go in peace.
